companies.name: ヤンセン・バイオテック

relations.text: イムブルビカの米国外での独占販売権を得ている
relations.text_en: Janssen holds the exclusive license to commercialize Imbruvica outside the United States

source.label: AbbVie Inc. 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The collaboration provides Janssen with an exclusive license to commercialize Imbruvica outside of the United States and co-exclusively with AbbVie in the United States.

relations.text: ベネクレクスタを含むBCL-2阻害薬を共同で開発・商業化する
relations.text_en: AbbVie and Genentech jointly develop and commercialize BCL-2 inhibitors including Venclexta

source.label: AbbVie Inc. 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: AbbVie and Genentech, a member of the Roche Group, are parties to a collaboration and license agreement executed in 2007 to jointly research, develop and commercialize human therapeutic products containing BCL-2 inhibitors and certain other compound inhibitors which included Venclexta, a BCL-2 inhibitor used to treat certain hematological malignancies.

relations.text: 2025年4月にライセンス契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: AbbVie entered into a licensing agreement with Gubra in April 2025

source.label: AbbVie Inc. 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Gubra A/S In April 2025, AbbVie entered into a licensing agreement with Gubra A/S.

relations.text: 2025年12月期の末日より後にライセンス契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: AbbVie entered into a license agreement with RemeGen after December 31, 2025

source.label: AbbVie Inc. 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Subsequent to December 31, 2025, AbbVie announced that it entered into a license agreement with RemeGen Co., Ltd. (RemeGen).

relations.text: 買収したセレベルが結んだ特許ライセンス契約を引き継いだ
relations.text_en: AbbVie assumed Cerevel's licensing agreement with Pfizer

source.label: AbbVie Inc. 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: AbbVie also assumed a licensing agreement entered into by Cerevel Therapeutics with Pfizer Inc. (Pfizer) prior to the acquisition.

relations.text: 米国の医薬品売上のほぼ全てを占める卸売業者三社の一つである
relations.text_en: It is one of three wholesalers that accounted for substantially all U.S. pharmaceutical product sales

source.label: AbbVie Inc. 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: In 2025, three wholesale distributors (McKesson Corporation, Cardinal Health, Inc. and Cencora, Inc.) accounted for substantially all of AbbVie's pharmaceutical product sales in the United States.
